result.question: Why does Abimelech ask his armor-bearer to kill him?

readings.answer: To prevent people from saying a woman killed him.
readings.support: lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’

readings.answer: Because he was mortally wounded when a woman crushed his skull.
readings.support: a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.

assessments.reason: Matches the stated motive in 9:54: “lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’”
While 9:53 shows he was gravely wounded, 9:54 gives his reason: “lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him,’” not because of the injury itself.

result.reason: Verse 9:54 explicitly states Abimelech’s reason: to prevent people from saying a woman killed him.
